As long as the caster and the target are in this state, reflects damage suffered by the caster onto the target and vice versa.

changements.avant:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Water damage and remove AP depending on its Combo in an area of effect when it explodes.
• Combo I to IV: -0 AP
• Combo V to IX: -1 AP
• Combo X to XV: -2 AP

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The wall of Water Bombs only removes AP from entities that start their turn inside it.
• Wall of Water: -2 AP

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Water Bombs present on the field.

• By removing the spell's effects if it is cast on another Bomb.

The effects are removed if the Bomb is triggered by an explosion effect.

changements.avant:
Switches places with the target and applies the Kaboom state to the caster.
• On an ally: also applies the state to them.
• On one of the caster's Elemental Bombs: adds 1 Combo to the Bomb.
Applies the Imposture state to the caster and the targeted ally on the next turn, which prevents the Kaboom state from being applied.

The Combo and the Kaboom state are only applied if the position switch can occur.

changements.avant:
Applies a shield on the caster, inflicts damage in the caster's best attack element on enemies, and repels the target.
The effects become stronger based on the mask worn by the caster:
• Intrepid state: shield is strongest.
• Cowardly state: pushback is strongest.
• Psychopathic state: damage is strongest.

Each mask change reduces the spell's cooldown period by one turn.
changements.apres:
Applies a shield on the caster, inflicts damage in the caster's best attack element on enemies, and repels the target.
The effects become stronger based on the mask worn by the caster:

• Coward: pushback is strongest.
• Psychopath: damage is strongest.

Each mask change reduces the spell's cooldown period by 1 turn.

changements.avant:
Applies the Transfiguration state on the caster and the targeted enemy, and applies effects on the enemy depending on which mask is worn:
• Intrepid state: reduces final damage inflicted.
• Cowardly state: reduces ranged resistances.
• Psychopathic state: reduces close-combat resistances.
Stacking is shared among effects.

Each mask change reduces the spell's cooldown period by 1 turn and reapplies the spell's effects if the caster is in the Transfiguration state.
changements.apres:

Each mask change reduces the spell's cooldown period by 1 turn and reapplies the spell's effects as long as the caster is in the state.

changements.avant:
Changes the targeted enemy's elemental state based on its current state:
•  Earth →  Water →  Fire →  Air →  Earth

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed on the first casting on a target.
changements.apres:
Changes the elemental state on the targeted enemy clockwise based on their current state:
•  Earth →  Water →  Fire →  Air →  Earth

On an enemy without an elemental state: applies the elemental state of the last rune placed by the caster.

The spell's AP cost is reimbursed the first time a target changes states.
